title: Verification note identity checks
responsibility: Detects contradictions between a stored verification record, its indexing note and the actual commit tree.

inputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity.record
inputs.description: Verification record whose identity fields are authoritative for comparison.

inputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity.note
inputs.description: Verification history-note entry to compare with the record.

inputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity.tree
inputs.description: Actual commit tree hash, or null/undefined when unavailable.

outputs.name: verificationNoteIdentity
outputs.description: All mismatch messages in fixed order for record id, source commit/tree, outcome, note tree/base, profile and finish time; empty when they agree.
